notes.title: We are working on fixes
notes.content: [p][b][u]FIXES COMING YOUR WAY SOON.[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]We thank you all for your support so far. We are working on some fixes such as asset clipping, teleportation into different levels and some general sorting out of game logic. We aim to get these issues sorted by 31st October 2025 to ensure our players have a good experience. We thank you all again for supporting our journey.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127725/630e190a9af2ef112f437fc146c19a4d2bfebf28.png"][/img][/p]
